rows.rationale: Moved the binary LCS definitions and completed results from WantedExt/Combinatorics/BinaryChvatalSankoffWanted.lean when the strict positivity bound was proved, preserving declaration names and statements. Also: The moved docstring keeps ATLAS-side text from WantedExt/Combinatorics/BinaryChvatalSankoffWanted.lean that Formal-Math does not have yet (its backport is still owed). Also: Restore the complete source paragraph for the strict positivity theorem. Also: Remove the obsolete proof-status sentence from the strict positivity docstring. Also: Reinstate the final sentence of the wanted citation verbatim. Also: Drop the sentence saying that its proof is not supplied from the strict positivity docstring, which the proof made false (reviews of #7972); this supersedes the reinstatement above, the Chvátal–Sankoff citation stays, and a comment in the proof explains the argument. Also: Restore the full Chvátal–Sankoff reference in the module docstring as requested in the review of #7972.

Restate docstrings to match the Lean statements (Atlas wiki audit, #988). Also: ATLAS-side edit for the v4.36.0 toolchain bump: it now refers to the declarations formerly in the namespace `Cslib.Logic.PL` by their names in `Cslib.Logic.LegacyPL`, because CSLib v4.36.0 declares its new `Proposition` as `Cslib.Logic.PL.Proposition`; formal-math needs the same renaming when it moves to v4.36.0.
